aiSettings.title: AI Settings
aiSettings.subtitle: Govern model aliases, feature flags, budget and AI rollout state for the whole platform.
aiSettings.permissionBody: Only university administrators may view and change AI configuration.
aiSettings.secrecyNote: For security, this surface shows only alias names, feature flags and derived status — never a provider, model name or key.
aiSettings.providerRegistryMaskedBody: The real provider and model registry — provider names, connection endpoints and concrete model identifiers — is managed by platform operations. Your workspace configures masked aliases, budgets and feature flags only.
aiSettings.whyEnabled: Real AI calls are enabled and active.
aiSettings.whyAvailable: The environment allows real calls, but the admin toggle or rollout state is keeping AI off. Enable it in the activation section below.
aiSettings.whyOfflineNoKey: AI is off — no provider key is configured, so no real calls can be made.
aiSettings.whyOfflineEnvBlocked: AI is off — real calls are blocked by the system environment configuration.
aiSettings.modelsSubtitle: Choose an alias per task family. Only alias names are shown — never a concrete provider or model.
aiSettings.flagsSubtitle: Turn AI-assisted features on or off per task.
aiSettings.cvStructuringHelp: Allow the AI fallback step that structures uploaded CV content.
aiSettings.jobFitHelp: Add an AI-generated explanation to the CV-to-job fit score.
aiSettings.activationSubtitle: Control whether real AI calls are enabled and the rollout state.
aiSettings.realCallsHelp: This toggle only takes effect once the environment and provider key are ready; until then AI stays off.
aiSettings.rolloutHelp: Paused or offline forces real calls off while keeping aliases and flags for a quick re-enable.
aiSettings.budgetHelp: Per-day spend ceiling, from 0 to 10,000 USD.
aiSettings.conflictBody: These settings were just updated elsewhere. The latest version has been reloaded.
aiSettings.killBody: This stops all real AI calls and sets the rollout state to offline.
aiSettings.killNote: Aliases and feature flags are preserved so you can re-enable later. This is an emergency switch.
aiSettings.killReasonHint: Record why AI was disabled for the audit trail.
aiSettings.killedToast: AI disabled. All real calls have stopped.
aiSettings.routingCanvasSubtitle: Drag and drop to view and configure AI provider priority per task family.
aiSettings.routingActivateConfirmBody: This immediately applies the primary/fallback provider order for the selected task family.
aiSettings.routingHealthEmpty: No providers are configured for this task family's alias yet.
aiSettings.routingLoadErrorTitle: Could not load the routing graph
aiSettings.routingPermissionBody: Only university administrators holding the provider-identity permission see raw identity; others see curated labels only.
aiSettings.routingSaveErrorToast: Could not save the routing graph. Please try again.
aiSettings.routingNoProviderTitle: No providers on this graph yet
aiSettings.routingNoProviderBody: Drag the "Provider" block onto the canvas and save a draft before activating.
